title: 影子钟
subtitle: 太阳在走，影子也在走
character: wearing a plain blue t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in woodcut print style on warm ochre paper, bold carved shapes with strong black lines and visible carving marks, limited palette of black, ochre and brick red

pages.zh:
中午在院子里，
我发现自己的影子
缩成小小的一团。
可是早上，
它还长得像根竹竿。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a sunny yard at midday looking down at his short shadow on the ground, puzzled.

pages.zh:
影子会变，
是因为太阳在天上移动。
早上太阳在东边，
中午升到最高，
傍晚又落到西边。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one curved dotted line arching across the top of an ochre background from left to right, with three suns drawn on it: low at the left, high in the middle, low at the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太阳低的时候，
光是斜着照过来的，
影子就拖得很长。
太阳高的时候，
光快要直着照下来，影子就很短。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two stick poles standing on ochre ground: the left one with a low sun and a long shadow, the right one with a high sun and a short shadow. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
影子的方向也在变。
太阳在东边，
影子就倒向西边；
太阳转到西边，
影子就换到东边去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one pole standing on ochre ground with a sun on the left casting its shadow to the right, and the same pole with a sun on the right casting its shadow to the left. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
很久以前的人就发现了这件事。
他们在地上插一根棍子，
看影子落在哪里，
就知道大概是什么时候。
这叫做「影子钟」。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight stick standing upright in ochre ground, its shadow falling to one side, with several short marks drawn on the ground in a fan shape around the stick. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
做一个很简单：
找一块平地，
插一根直直的棍子，
让它站得稳稳的，
不要歪。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight stick pushed upright into flat ochre ground, with two small stones placed at its base to hold it steady. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
早上八点，
在影子的顶端画一个记号，
写上八。
九点再画一个，
十点再画一个。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one upright stick on ochre ground with three short marks on the ground at the tip of its shadow, spaced apart along a curve. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
画满一整天，
地上就出现一排记号，
像一把展开的扇子。
以后不用看表，
看影子落在哪个记号上就行了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one upright stick on ochre ground with a fan of eight short marks spread around it, each at a different angle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不过影子钟有两个脾气：
阴天没有影子，它就不工作；
晚上太阳下山了，
它也只好休息。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one upright stick on ochre ground with a thick cloud drawn above it and no shadow on the ground at all. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
而且同一个记号，
冬天和夏天还不太一样。
因为太阳在天上走的路，
冬天低一些，
夏天高一些。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two arcs across an ochre background, the upper arc higher and longer, the lower arc flatter and shorter, each with a small sun drawn on it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
后来，人们做出了水钟、沙漏、
摆钟，还有手表。
可是最早告诉人们时间的，
是太阳，
和地上那一道影子。
pages.scene: Four simple objects in a row on an ochre background: a water clock jar, an hourglass, a pendulum clock and a wristwatch, all woodcut style. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我在院子里插了一根棍子，
每过一个小时就画一道。
画到傍晚，
地上有了一把小扇子。
明天，我要看它准不准。
pages.scene: The little boy crouches in a sunny yard beside an upright stick, drawing a mark on the ground with a piece of chalk, several marks already around the stick.
